Subject: Re: CloudRidge — draft case study for technical fact-check and clearance

Evelyn / Marissa,

Thanks — we reviewed and attached our redlines (CR_redlines_v1.pdf). High-level points:
1) Cost savings: the current draft states "40% reduction in inference spend". That number reflects a best-case internal test. Our production metric is closer to 28% over our Q1 workload after caching; please change any published number to 28% (or say "~30%" if you want rounding).
2) Latency: the 50% latency claim is only true for burst workloads on our staging cluster. In production our measurements are ~42% for long-tail requests — you can publish "~40%".
3) Product naming: please refer to the offering as "Redwood Dedicated" (not Redwood Dedicated Cluster).
4) Quote: the engineer quote attributed to our SRE (internal name) is not cleared for publication. We can provide an approved quote from our Head of ML Ops (short sentence) but it needs to be reviewed first.
5) Logo use: we are fine with the standard logo file, but legal requires a short release form.

We're attaching the redlines and a suggested short quote from our Head of ML Ops: "Redwood's platform let us standardize inference across teams and cut our end-to-end latency substantially." We'll confirm the precise phrasing after legal sign-off.

Attachment: [Attachment: CR_redlines_v1.pdf (pdf)]

Sam
Samantha Lee
Director of Product Marketing | CloudRidge

Can you: 1) validate the numbers in our vendor-facing wording and provide conservative public-safe replacements, 2) update the technical paragraph to accurately reflect the architecture and caching behavior, and 3) produce an updated draft we can send back to Sam for sign-off?

Evelyn

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>

Subject: Re: Fwd: CloudRidge — draft case study for technical fact-check and clearance

Eve / team — thanks for the ping. I reviewed the draft and Sam's redlines. My suggested public-safe updates:
- Cost savings: replace specific "40%" with "~30% reduction in inference spend in production workloads" (this aligns with their request and gives a small buffer).
- Latency: change to "reduced end-to-end inference latency by ~40% in production, with larger improvements observed in burst scenarios".
- Architecture line: simplify to "CloudRidge adopted Redwood Dedicated with prefix caching and workload-aware batching to reduce per-token compute and lower variance in tail latency."
- Quote handling: agree remove the SRE quote until CloudRidge provides a signed line. Offer their suggested quote verbatim but mark it as "proposed" until legal clears.

I've prepared suggested replacement paragraphs and added a short caption for the figure. Also generating a PNG of the updated latency/cost figure: [Attachment: cloudridge-figs-v2.png (png)].

If that looks good I'll push a revised draft (v4) and send to Sam + legal with a DocuSign link for logo/quote permission.

Ben
Ben Carter
Director, Customer Marketing | Redwood Inference
